target_customer: Frontend developers and designers on product teams that use Storybook and Figma
problem: Designers and developers drift apart when UI is built from Figma specs, so teams lack a fast way to see differences between the coded component and the design.
business_model: B2B SaaS developer tool, Storybook addon (pricing not found)
product_category: Developer tools, design to code handoff

founders.name: Jono Kolnik
founders.background_notes: Listed as the only founder on the YC page. Storybook's own Figma plugin posts credit Jono Kolnik among the developers of the Storybook Connect plugin, which suggests an engineering background. No employer or education found.

exit.reason: The product site says We are no longer live but thank you for all your support. No cause is given.

technical_complexity.rationale: A Storybook addon that compares coded components to Figma designs needs Figma API access, token syncing and rendering comparison, standard engineering with some hard parts for a very small team.

defensibility.rationale: The wedge depended on the Storybook and Figma ecosystems and could be copied by plugin authors or by the platforms themselves.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Storybook published its own Figma plugin that links stories to Figma components, covering part of the same wedge. Source: storybook.js.org Figma plugin posts, dates not confirmed here.

market_need_then: Design to code drift is a widely discussed pain for teams adopting design systems, but no spend or customer evidence for this product was found.

branding.domain_note: Product site used mismatch.app, not a contrast domain. Product Hunt lists a contrast.app product launched 2021-05-28 and a separate unrelated Contrast color tool exists.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product copy about telling you the difference between code and Figma designs

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; the name is shared with several other products and the product used a different domain name.

outcome_analysis: Contrast built a small Storybook addon for comparing code with Figma designs and went through YC in Summer 2018. The product site later said it was no longer live and no cause is public. The failure factors are inferred from the market: Storybook shipped its own Figma plugin and design handoff was a crowded niche, so willingness to pay for an addon is a plausible weak point. This is judgment, not stated by the founder.
notes: Outcome search did not find a shutdown post; cause not public. Competitor search found only undated or later comparison pages, so the list is empty. The $125K seed rests on a single database (Dealroom) and the match to this company is inferred from the YC page linking a Crunchbase slug named toybox, and Dealroom describing a DOM capture tool; treat as unverified. Product Hunt launch of contrast.app is dated 2021, after the batch.
